modules.topics: Data Structures: Basic Terminologies – Algorithms: Definition, Pseudocode Representation – Time complexity and space complexity – efficiency of algorithms – O-notation – Omega notation and Theta Notation – Arrays: One dimensional & multidimensional arrays – Searching.
